description: Equipment and consumables. Filled by the cycle 2 bridge prefab dump. SCHEMA_VERSION 2 amended 2026-07-26 after the first real dump: stats was an object mapping a stat name to a number, and it is now a list, because a name-keyed map cannot carry ModificationType. MEASURED over 425 items and 899 stat entries: three modification kinds occur - Add 665, AddToBase 232, MultiplyBaseAdd 2 - so PhysicalPower Add 10 and PhysicalPower AddToBase 10 are different stats that a map would render identically. NOT the reason: duplicate StatType collapse. Zero of the 425 items carry a repeated StatType on this build, so that argument was checked and found false rather than assumed true. UNVALIDATED NESTED SHAPE still applies: validate_table checks only that stats is a list; core/table_deep.py is what inspects the entries.

category.description: weapon, chest, legs, gloves, boots, cloak, jewel, consumable, other.

tier.description: Gear tier, 0 when the item has none.

stats.description: One entry per ModifyUnitStatBuff_DOTS element on the item prefab, read one hop with no BuffGuid follow. Each entry is an object with stat (StatType name), modification (ModificationType name) and value (number). Observed 2026-07-26: 0 to 6 entries per item, 29 distinct StatTypes, values 0 to 500.

weapon_type.description: Weapon family when category is weapon, otherwise empty.
